description: For a homeowner reporting a problem: the safe first steps to do now, what not to do, who to call first (the gas emergency service 0800 111 999 for a gas smell or CO alarm), whether it is a real emergency, and an `urgency` value of routine, soon or emergency that matches Nero Work's three job speeds, raised for water near electrics, a bulging ceiling, a vulnerable person in the cold, or water that cannot be stopped. Also returns `nero_work_job` (urgency, category, summary) ready to post. Typical call: {"situation":"no_heat","vulnerable_people":true,"outside_temp_c":2,"other_heating_available":false}.

nation.description: Changes the gas emergency number for Northern Ireland.

trade.description: Optional. The plumber or heating engineer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1, the same shape as Spark Pack and Nero Work). Used to prefill records and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Flow Pack.

categories.description: Trades offered, using Nero Work trade names. Defaults to ["plumber", "heating"].

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Northside Plumbing & Heating".

licence_body.description: Registration scheme. For gas work use gas_safe with the business's Gas Safe registration number.

licence_number.description: Scheme registration number (Gas Safe registration numbers are usually 6 or 7 digits).

vulnerable_people.description: Elderly, very young, disabled or medically vulnerable person in the home.

water_stopped.description: Has turning off the stop tap or valve stopped the water?

name: emergency_triage
title: Emergency triage for leaks, bursts, no heat, gas smell or CO alarm
